category_selection_rule: Hiding categories selects rows for display; never recompute the source denominator or renormalize the remaining rows.
combination_rule: Use only combinations present in the named source after its fixed row selection. Table families and alternate groupings are not additive or freely joinable.
selection_semantics: OR within a field; AND across fields; every selected value must occur in a matching released tuple. Unsupported rows do not grant a selection.
